newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq makes small gains despite Microsoft.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq makes small gains despite Microsoft.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks rode a late-session rally to end with small gains, despite a downturn in market heavyweight Microsoft Corp.
Buying in other technology stocks, including gravity-defying Dell Computer Corp, carried the day.
The Nasdaq composite rose about a point to 1569, after having been down almost 15 at its session low.
"Closing near the high of the day bodes real well heading into tomorrow," said Peter Coolidge, senior equity trader at Brean Murray and Co.
Microsoft fell 3-7/16 to 138 after executives said the software company expects to increase research and development as well as marketing expenses in the current fiscal year.
Dell added to its recent gains amid a rally in PC stocks, gaining six to a 52-week high of 170. The stock's 52-week low is 22-5/8.
Tekelec rose 9-9/16 to 56-5/16. SoundView raised 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates on the communications test equipment maker after it posted quarterly results.
Medical device company Nellcor Puritan Bennett shot up 7-5/32 to 28-3/32 after it agreed to be bought by Mallinckrodt Inc for about $1.9 billion.
